description: Performance.FYI is the Moody's of workforce performance management quality. We provide a universal A-F grade measuring organizational health. Unlike subjective surveys, our proprietary framework conducts an objective, systems-based audit of a company's core operational infrastructure, creating a leading indicator of future performance and risk.
problem_statement:
The Problem
Companies spend billions on engagement surveys and performance management tools, yet leadership teams and boards still lack a clear, objective measure of workforce performance. Existing tools produce subjective data—gamable survey results, inconsistent ratings, and biased manager input—that fails to capture how well performance systems are actually designed and functioning. This creates blind spots in culture, productivity, and risk. Leaders are left making critical compensation, promotion, and talent decisions on shaky ground.

Why It Matters
When organizations can’t accurately measure the quality of their performance management systems, they can’t improve them. Poorly designed systems erode trust, slow decision-making, drive attrition, and ultimately destroy shareholder value. Investors, boards, and executives increasingly want transparency into workforce quality—just as they demand audited financials. By solving this problem, we’re enabling companies to shift from opinion-based metrics to a universal, evidence-based grade of performance management health. That matters not only for organizational effectiveness, but also for fairness, equity, and building cultures that actually perform.
